title: "Systematic Review Summary Report"
output:
  bookdown::html_document2:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    toc_depth: 2
    number_sections: true
params:
  data_path: "generated_data/processed_estimate_data.rds"
  who_data_path: "Data/endemicity/who_annual_report.csv"
  location_file_path: "Data/endemicity/country_location_id_name.csv"

```{r setup, echo=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
source(here::here("Analysis/utils.R"))
library(gtsummary)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)
library(survey)

# Load the dataset from the file path
data <- readRDS(here::here(params$data_path)) %>% 
  mutate(study_year_tl = lubridate::year(eff_tl),
         study_year_tr = lubridate::year(eff_tr))
```

# Exposure summary
```{r}
# Total number of studies
total_studies <- n_distinct(data$studykey)

# Number of studies with more than 1 exposure
studies_with_more_than_one_exposure <- data %>% 
  distinct(studykey, exp_class) %>% 
  group_by(studykey) %>% 
  summarize(n_exp = length(unique(exp_class))) %>% 
  mutate(n_exp = ifelse(n_exp ==1,n_exp,">1")) %>% 
  filter(n_exp == ">1") %>% 
  count(n_exp, name = 'n_studies') %>% 
  pull(n_studies)

exposure_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, exp_class) %>%
  count(exp_class, name = "n_studies") %>%
  add_row(exp_class = ">1 exposure class", n_studies = studies_with_more_than_one_exposure) %>% 
  add_row(exp_class = "Total", n_studies = total_studies)

exposure_counts %>%
  rename(Exposure = exp_class, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Exposure, values_from = `Number of Studies`) %>%
  mutate(Metric = "Number of Studies") %>%
  relocate(Metric) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Exposure Count Summary") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Metric, decimals = 0)

```

# Outcome summary
```{r}
# Outcome counts
outcome_counts <- data %>%
  distinct(studykey, out_class_metric) %>%
  count(out_class_metric, name = "n_studies") %>%
  add_row(out_class_metric = "Total", n_studies = total_studies)

outcome_counts %>%
  rename(`Outcome` = out_class_metric, `Number of Studies` = n_studies) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Overall Outcome Summary") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = `Number of Studies`, decimals = 0)

```

```{r}
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = exp_class,
    values_from = n,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  rename(Outcome = out_class_metric)

outcome_tbl %>%

  tab_header(title = "Outcome Summary by Exposure") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = -Outcome, decimals = 0)

```

# Study period summary 
```{r}
period_table <- data %>% 
  mutate(across(c("eff_tl", "eff_tr"), ~ char_to_date(.) %>% as.Date())) %>% 
  mutate(study_year_tl = lubridate::year(eff_tl),
         study_year_tr = lubridate::year(eff_tr)) %>% 
  mutate(duration = as.numeric(eff_tr-eff_tl)) %>% 
  mutate(study_duration = case_when(
    duration <= 366 ~ "<1 year",
    duration <= 366*2 ~ "1-2 years",
    duration <= 366*5 ~ "2-5 years",
    duration <= 366*10 ~ "5-10 years",
    TRUE ~ ">10 years"
  ))

```

## Study period coverage 
```{r}
period_table %>%
  summarize(
    `Earliest Study Year` = min(study_year_tl, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Latest Study Year` = max(study_year_tr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Overall Study Period Coverage") %>%
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0)
```

```{r}
stats_all <- generate_summary_stats(data)

# Add scores to dataframe
data_scores <- data %>% 
  get_study_scores()

stats_by_continent <- map(
  unique(data$continent), 
  function(x) {
    data %>% 
      filter(continent == x) %>% 
      generate_summary_stats()
  }
) %>% 
  magrittr::set_names(unique(data$continent))

stats_by_score <- map(
  unique(data_scores$hq_score), 
  function(x) {
    data_scores %>% 
      filter(hq_score == x) %>% 
      generate_summary_stats(regenerate_score = F)
  }
) %>% 
  magrittr::set_names(unique(data_scores$hq_score))


study_counts <- stats_all$study_counts
```

# Table 1
```{r}
# Helper function: generate summary table with Total column
make_summary_table1 <- function(data, var, rename_var = NULL, output_cols = c("Overall","by exp"),  exp_class_order = c("precipitation", "temperature", "flood","drought","Overall")
) {
  if(c("by exp") %in% output_cols){
    tmp_exp <- data %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
      distinct(studykey, exp_class, .data[[var]]) %>%
      count(.data[[var]], exp_class) 
  } else {
    tmp_exp <- data.frame()
  }
  
  if(c("Overall") %in% output_cols){
    tmp_total <- data %>%
      mutate(across(all_of(var), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
      distinct(studykey, .data[[var]]) %>%
      count(.data[[var]]) %>%
      mutate(exp_class="Overall")    
  } else {
    tmp_total <- data.frame()
  }
  
  if(!nrow(tmp_exp) == 0 & !nrow(tmp_total) == 0){
    tmp <- tmp_exp %>%
      bind_rows(tmp_total)
  } else if(nrow(tmp_exp) == 0){
    tmp <- tmp_total
  } else {
    tmp <- tmp_exp
  }
  
  tmp_long <- tmp %>% 
    rename(!!rename_var := .data[[var]])
  
  if (!is.null(exp_class_order)) {
    tmp_long <- tmp_long %>%
      mutate(exp_class = factor(exp_class, levels = exp_class_order))
  }
  
  # Create a survey design object to account for weights
  survey_design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = tmp_long, weights = ~n)
  
  summary_tbl <- tbl_svysummary(
    survey_design,  # Use the survey design object
    by = exp_class,  # Group by Category (Africa, Asia, Other)
    includ = Category,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),  # Show counts and percentages
    missing = "no"  # Exclude missing data from summary
  )
  
  summary_tbl <- as_tibble(summary_tbl)
  
  # Round the percentage
  summary_tbl <- summary_tbl %>% 
    mutate(across(contains("%"), ~ceiling(as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9.-]", "", .))), .names = "rounded_{.col}"))
  
  return(as_gtsummary(summary_tbl))
}
```

## Table 1. Spatial-temporal characteristics
### Table 1. Study region
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data = data, "continent", "Category")
```

### Table 1. Study country
```{r}
get_country_count_by_continent <- function(data, ctn = NULL, ctn_col = "continent") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  
  clean_data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(ctn_col, "eff_country")), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
    separate_rows(eff_country, sep = "\\|") %>%
    distinct(studykey, .data[[ctn_col]], eff_country, exp_class) %>%
    rename(continent = !!sym(ctn_col))
  
  if (!is.null(ctn)) {
    clean_data <- clean_data %>%
      filter(continent == tolower(ctn))
  }
  
  top_by_exp <- clean_data %>%
    group_by(exp_class, eff_country) %>%
    summarise(n = n_distinct(studykey), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(exp_class) %>%
    slice_max(order_by = n, n = 1, with_ties = T) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  top_country_grid <- top_by_exp %>%
    distinct(eff_country) %>%
    crossing(exp_class = unique(clean_data$exp_class))
  
  country_counts <- clean_data %>%
    semi_join(top_country_grid, by = "eff_country") %>%
    group_by(eff_country, exp_class) %>%
    summarise(n_papers = n_distinct(studykey), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(top_country_grid, by = c("eff_country", "exp_class")) %>%
    mutate(n_papers = replace_na(n_papers, 0)) %>%
    arrange(eff_country, exp_class)
  
  top_countries <- unique(top_by_exp$eff_country)
  
  others_counts <- clean_data %>%
    filter(!eff_country %in% top_countries) %>%
    group_by(exp_class) %>%
    summarise(
      eff_country = "Others",
      n_papers = n_distinct(studykey),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  country_counts_with_others <- bind_rows(country_counts, others_counts) %>%
    arrange(eff_country, exp_class)
  
  return(country_counts_with_others)
}


get_country_count <- function(data, country_continent_by_ctn, ctn = "africa", ctn_col = "continent") {
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(survey)
  library(gtsummary)
  
  clean_data <- data %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(c(ctn_col, "eff_country")), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
    separate_rows(eff_country, sep = "\\|") %>%
    distinct(studykey, !!sym(ctn_col), eff_country)
  
  continent_data <- clean_data %>%
    filter(!!sym(ctn_col) == tolower(ctn))
  
  top_countries <- unique(country_continent_by_ctn$eff_country)
  
  country_counts <- continent_data %>%
    filter(eff_country %in% top_countries) %>%
    group_by(eff_country) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n_distinct(studykey),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  other_n <- continent_data %>%
    filter(!eff_country %in% top_countries) %>%
    pull(studykey) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()
  
  total_n <- continent_data %>%
    pull(studykey) %>%
    unique() %>%
    length()
  
  # Other countries
  summary_data <- country_counts %>%
    select(eff_country, n) %>%
    mutate(continent = ctn) %>%
    bind_rows(
      tibble(
        eff_country = "Others",
        n = other_n,
        continent = ctn
      )
    ) %>%
    relocate(continent)
  
  survey_design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = summary_data, weights = ~n)
  
  tbl <- tbl_svysummary(
    survey_design,
    by = "continent",
    include = "eff_country",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
    modify_caption(glue::glue("**Summary Table for Continent (overall): {str_to_title(ctn)}**"))
  
  # Overall
  overall_row <- tibble(
    variable = "eff_country",
    group = NA,
    label = "Overall",
    stat_1 = as.character(total_n)
  )
  
  tbl_df <- as_tibble(tbl$table_body)
  final_tbl <- tbl %>%
    modify_table_body(
      ~ bind_rows(.x, overall_row)
    )
  
  return(final_tbl)
}
```

### Table 1. % of years with WHO reported cases 
```{r}
who_data<-read.csv(here::here(params$who_data_path)) %>%
  tidyr::separate(obs,c('time_left','time_right','suspected_cases','deaths','location_id','primary'),sep = ';',remove=T) %>%
  filter(primary == 't') %>% 
  merge(.,read.csv(here::here(params$location_file_path)),by.x="location_id",by.y="id",all.x=TRUE) %>%
  filter(is.na(region)==F) %>%
  arrange(region) %>%
  mutate(country = as.factor(region),suspected_cases=as.numeric(suspected_cases)) %>% 
  filter(time_right >= as.Date("2000-01-01") & time_right <= as.Date("2023-12-31")) %>% 
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(time_right)) %>% 
  select(country,suspected_cases,year)

summary_tbl <- identify_endemicity(
  processed_data = data,
  who_data = who_data,
  group_col = 'exp_class'
) %>%
  mutate(endemicity_group = case_when(
    percent_year_with_cases <= 50 ~ "0-50%",
    percent_year_with_cases > 50 & percent_year_with_cases <= 95 ~ "50-95%",
    percent_year_with_cases > 95 ~ ">95%"
  )) %>%
  group_by(endemicity_group, exp_class) %>%
  summarize(n = n_distinct(country), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(exp_class) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1),
         formatted = paste0(n, " (", percent, "%)")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(endemicity_group, exp_class, formatted) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = exp_class, values_from = formatted, values_fill = "0 (0%)") 

summary_tbl %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Study Population by Endemicity Group and Exposure Type")
```

## Table 2. Data quality table (temporarily)
```{r}
get_study_scores_by_question <- function(
  df,
  study_id_var = "studykey",
  question_vars = c(
    "exp_temp_tf", "exp_spatial_tf", "exp_source_tf",
    "out_class_case_presentation_tf", "out_temp_tf", "out_spatial_tf",
    "out_case_df_tf", "a_class_tf",
    "a_uncert_def_tf"
  )
) {
  by_keys <- c(study_id_var, "exp_class", "out_class_metric")

  scored <- df %>%
    make_scores()

  out <- scored %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(by_keys))) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      n_estimates            = dplyr::n(),
      min_tot_score_est      = min(tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_exp_tot_score_est  = min(exp_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_out_tot_score_est  = min(out_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      min_a_tot_score_est    = min(a_tot_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      dplyr::across(
        dplyr::all_of(question_vars),
        ~ min(as.numeric(.x), na.rm = TRUE),
        .names = "{.col}_min"
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      hq_score = dplyr::if_else(min_tot_score_est == 9, "complete-score", "imperfect-score")
    )

  return(out)
}

quality_data_by_question <- data %>% get_study_scores_by_question()

make_quality_table <- function(
  data,
  question_vars,
  question_labels = NULL,
  study_id_var = "studykey",
  exp_var = "exp_class",
  out_var = "out_class_metric",
  exp_class_order = c("precipitation", "temperature", "flood", "drought", "Overall")
) {
  
  per_study_exp <- data %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(study_id_var, exp_var)))) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(question_vars), min),
      .groups = "drop"
)

  overall_by_exp <- per_study_exp %>%
    dplyr::distinct(dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(c(study_id_var, exp_var)))) %>%
    dplyr::count(!!rlang::sym(exp_var), name = "N_total")

  per_study_overall <- per_study_exp %>%
      dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(study_id_var)) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(question_vars), min),
        .groups = "drop"
  )

  total_overall <- per_study_overall %>%
    dplyr::summarise(N_total = dplyr::n()) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(!!exp_var := "Overall")

  counts_overall_by_question <- per_study_overall %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = dplyr::all_of(question_vars),
        names_to = "question",
        values_to = "val"
      ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(question) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(val == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(!!exp_var := "Overall")

  counts_by_question_exp <- per_study_exp %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = dplyr::all_of(question_vars),
      names_to = "question",
      values_to = "val"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(!!rlang::sym(exp_var), question) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(n = sum(val == 1, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  denoms <- dplyr::bind_rows(overall_by_exp, total_overall)
  counts <- dplyr::bind_rows(counts_by_question_exp, counts_overall_by_question)

  counts2 <- counts %>%
    dplyr::left_join(denoms, by = exp_var) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct = 100 * n / N_total,
      display = paste0(n, " (", round(pct, 0), "%)")
    ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(question = dplyr::recode(question, !!!question_labels)) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate(!!exp_var := factor(.data[[exp_var]], levels = exp_class_order))

  wide <- counts2 %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = question,
      names_from = !!rlang::sym(exp_var),
      values_from = display
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(question)

    for (col in exp_class_order) {
    wide <- wide[, c("question", exp_class_order[exp_class_order %in% names(wide)])]
    }

  gt::gt(wide) %>%
    gt::cols_label(question = "Category") %>%
    gt::fmt_missing(columns = gt::everything(), missing_text = "0 (0%)")
}


question_vars <- c(
  "exp_temp_tf_min","exp_spatial_tf_min","exp_source_tf_min",
  "out_class_case_presentation_tf_min","out_temp_tf_min","out_spatial_tf_min",
  "out_case_df_tf_min","a_class_tf_min","a_uncert_def_tf_min"
)
```

```{r}
  group_by(out_medicattended) %>% 
  summarize(n_study = length(unique(studykey)))
colnames(data)
cat(sprintf("Almost all studies reported on medically-attended cholera, with only %d reporting on a mix of facility-reported and community-reported cases.",medattd_com_cholera$n_study[2]))
```
